result.summary: Rework of the five remarks of TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (step 16, gate pass 1). All five are new cases inside existing tests of tools/test/picker-page.test.js, so the counts do not change (64 QP, 23 QM, 12 QS, 99 in all; test( in the file 64 before and after; assert. 625 before, 697 after). F1 (Medium) QP-4b and QP-9f: each clause of 'something to lose' alone. At the load (QP-4b): another version with answers {business} and the place on the first question, language kk; another version with no answers and the place 'items', language en; each gives the notice in the stored language, no 'Continue', the value cleared to the new version with the language kept, and the next load has no notice. At a change of language (QP-9f): answers with the place on the first question (uchet-pro); a place beyond the first question with no answers (a small two-language file whose first question is optional, 'Next' with no answer); and the case with nothing to lose (no notice). F2 (Medium) QP-2d: after 'Next' with no new answer the stored place is the new question, and a reload plus 'Continue' opens it; the same after 'Back' (stored place, answers, reload plus 'Continue', the chosen answer), and 'Next' over answers already given; and after 'Back' from the result screen (the write log gets exactly one more setItem, the stored place is the last question, reload plus 'Continue' opens it). F3 (Medium) QP-9h: on the result screen kk then en, the requests of the result for both held, answered in both orders; the page stays on en (screen, html lang, aria-current of three buttons, document title, result text, one replaceState, address ?lang=en, stored lang, no net block). F4 (Low) QP-2e: 'Skip' on the last optional question with the net refused, for a choice and for a number: the question stays, the net block is of kind result, the field shows nothing (no option on / empty number field), the stored answers do not hold it, and 'Try again' sends the body without it. F5 (Low) QP-2g: the optional number is refused for '11', 'abc' (badInput) and '0' alike with the message, aria-invalid, storage and request count unchanged. Table criterion -> test (unchanged ids): criterion 2 -> QP-2d, QP-2e, QP-2g; criterion 4 -> QP-4a, QP-4b, QP-2d (position at a move); criterion 9 -> QP-9f, QP-9h. Quality-bar items: Q8 (QP-6a..6d, QM-3d, QM-3e) unchanged; Q10 (QP-7a..7g, and the net-refused cases of F4); Q11 not touched (the page builds no address from user input; QP-6d, QS-4); R3 not applicable (decision 0033). N35 note: with one tab it is invisible in the stored value (the place stored when the result was reached is already the last question), so the test pins the design rule E1 ('writes') by the write log.
